author: Kevin Stratvert
description:
Turn any YouTube video into text in seconds—without downloading tools or using third-party apps! In this video, I’ll show you exactly how to get a full YouTube transcript directly from YouTube itself. Whether you want to take notes, create blog content, or repurpose videos into something new, this simple method makes it incredibly easy.

You’ll also learn how to remove timestamps from transcripts using AI, plus how to use YouTube’s powerful new “Ask” feature to summarize videos, extract key points, and even find specific moments instantly.

What you’ll learn:
- How to access the YouTube transcript feature
- How to copy and use transcripts for notes or content creation
- The fastest way to remove timestamps using AI
- How to use YouTube’s new “Ask” feature
- How to find exact moments where words or phrases are mentioned
- How to turn videos into blog posts, summaries, and more

This is one of the easiest ways to boost your productivity and get more value out of any YouTube video!
